title: Cramer Answers: Does Owning the FAANG Stocks Make You Diversified? - TheStreet
text:
In , Jim Cramer addressed a member's question regarding the diversification of the portfolio.
The member thought the AAP portfolio was "heavily weighted in technology, financial, and some retail."
And he was curious as to how to "strike the right balance between sectors?"
Cramer readily admitted they own the FAANG stocks (Facebook ( FB ) , Amazon ( AMZN ) , Apple ( AAPL ) , Netflix ( NFLX ) , and Alphabet ( GOOG ) ) and that they were not going to sell them.
He talked about the industrials had not been "that fruitful," how they didn't do so well in their healthcare positions and why he is still a passionate defender of Citibank ( C ) and Goldman Sachs ( GS ) .
